description: Versioned offline features for recommendation training and inference.

customer_features.description: Customer activity aggregated from eligible, deduplicated purchases.

features.name: unique_products
features.description: Distinct products purchased by the customer.
features.transformation: Count distinct stock codes in the customer's Gold interactions.

features.name: purchase_line_count
features.description: Number of eligible purchase lines for the customer.
features.transformation: Sum purchase_line_count across the customer's product interactions.

features.name: total_units_purchased
features.description: Total positive units purchased by the customer.
features.transformation: Sum quantity_purchased across the customer's product interactions.

features.name: total_spend
features.description: Total recorded spend for the customer.
features.transformation: Sum interaction spend across all products for the customer.

features.name: first_purchase_at
features.description: Timestamp of the customer's earliest eligible purchase.
features.transformation: Minimum first_purchase_at across the customer's product interactions.

features.name: last_purchase_at
features.description: Timestamp of the customer's most recent eligible purchase.
features.transformation: Maximum last_purchase_at across the customer's product interactions.

product_features.description: Catalog and purchase activity features at product level.

features.name: description
features.description: Selected normalized catalog description for the product.
features.transformation: Most frequent non-empty Silver catalog description; ties are alphabetical.

features.name: catalog_record_count
features.description: Number of Silver catalog records for the product code.
features.transformation: Count catalog rows grouped by stock_code.

features.name: is_duplicate_catalog_code
features.description: Whether the catalog contains the product code more than once.
features.transformation: catalog_record_count greater than one.

features.name: purchase_line_count
features.description: Eligible purchase lines containing the product.
features.transformation: Sum interaction purchase_line_count grouped by stock_code.

features.name: unique_customers
features.description: Distinct customers who purchased the product.
features.transformation: Count distinct customer_id values grouped by stock_code.

features.name: units_sold
features.description: Total eligible units purchased for the product.
features.transformation: Sum interaction quantity_purchased grouped by stock_code.

features.name: gross_sales
features.description: Total recorded spend for the product.
features.transformation: Sum interaction spend grouped by stock_code.

features.name: first_sold_at
features.description: Earliest eligible purchase timestamp, empty for unsold catalog products.
features.transformation: Minimum first_purchase_at across interactions for the product.

features.name: last_sold_at
features.description: Most recent eligible purchase timestamp, empty for unsold catalog products.
features.transformation: Maximum last_purchase_at across interactions for the product.

features.name: popularity_rank
features.description: Popularity rank among products with sales; empty for unsold products.
features.transformation: Rank by unique_customers descending, then purchase_line_count descending, then stock_code.

customer_product_interactions.description: Customer-product implicit-feedback features for training and lookup.

features.name: purchase_line_count
features.description: Eligible purchase lines for this customer-product pair.
features.transformation: Count eligible deduplicated purchase lines grouped by customer_id and stock_code.

features.name: quantity_purchased
features.description: Total positive units bought by the customer from the product.
features.transformation: Sum quantity over eligible deduplicated purchase lines in the pair.

features.name: spend
features.description: Total recorded spend for the customer-product pair.
features.transformation: Sum line_total over eligible deduplicated purchase lines in the pair.

features.name: first_purchase_at
features.description: Earliest purchase timestamp for the pair.
features.transformation: Minimum invoice_datetime grouped by customer_id and stock_code.

features.name: last_purchase_at
features.description: Most recent purchase timestamp for the pair.
features.transformation: Maximum invoice_datetime grouped by customer_id and stock_code.
